# @tzezar/throtto

> Comprehensive, framework-agnostic TypeScript rate limiting.

## Overview

throtto is a TypeScript rate limiting library with 7 algorithms, 6 storage adapters, and 18 framework adapters. It uses functional composition (`pipe()`) and provides a unified API where every adapter exports `rateLimit`.

## Install

```
npm install @tzezar/throtto
```

## Quick Start

```ts
import { rateLimit } from '@tzezar/throtto'
const limiter = rateLimit('100/minute')
const result = await limiter.check('user-123')
```

## Core API

- `rateLimit(preset)` - create limiter from `'100/minute'` or `{ limit, window }`
- `createLimiter(config)` - full control (hooks, prefix, algorithm instances)
- `pipe(limiter, ...wrappers)` - functional composition

## Algorithms

fixed-window, sliding-window-counter (default), sliding-window-log, token-bucket, leaky-bucket, gcra, concurrency

## Stores

memory (default), redis, upstash, postgres, mysql, sqlite

## Framework Adapters

Every adapter exports `rateLimit` - import path identifies the framework:

```ts
import { rateLimit } from '@tzezar/throtto/adapters/express'
import { rateLimit } from '@tzezar/throtto/adapters/nextjs'
import { rateLimit } from '@tzezar/throtto/adapters/lambda'
```

Supported: Express, Fastify, Hono, Next.js, SvelteKit, Remix, Astro, NestJS, Elysia, H3, tRPC, WebSocket, Koa, Lambda, CloudFlare Workers, Bun, Deno, Generic HTTP

## Wrappers

withAllowlist, withDryRun, withOverride, withThresholds, withSoftHardLimit, withConditional, withBatch, withGracefulShutdown, withAnalytics

## Advanced Limiters

createCompoundLimiter, createTieredLimiter, createDynamicLimiter, createHierarchyLimiter, createScheduledLimiter, createLazyLimiter

## Patterns

throttle, debounce, createPenaltyBox, createQuota, withCostMapping, withBackpressure

## HTTP Utilities

toHeaders (RFC 9309), toErrorBody (RFC 7807), key resolvers (byIp, byUser, byApiKey, byComposite, byCustom, byPath), shouldSkip

## Testing

createTestLimiter, testClock, mockStore, assertAllowed, assertDenied, exhaust
